project.title: Sales Analysis Dashboard with SQL & Power BI
project.problemStatement: Analyzed declining sales in retail chain to identify loss drivers.
project.dataUsed: Sales and customer transaction data from POS systems over 6 months.
project.methodsApplied: SQL queries for data extraction; Power BI for ETL, data modeling, and interactive dashboard creation.
project.outcome: Improved sales strategy leading to 15% increase in monthly sales after dashboard adoption.
